MicrokARts: Designing Augmented Reality Enabled Karts for Co-Located Play with Children. MicrokARts is an Augmented Reality platform designed to help children design and program high-level electronics, while collaborating on tasks in a dynamic AR-IoT environment. Users (A) decide which electronics they want to put on their MicrokARt, (B) program their MicrokARt using our block-based live programming website, (C) dock the phone onto the MicrokARt, and (D) control their MicrokARt and play with others through AR-IoT interactions. Skills: Augmented Reality, IoT, Curriculum Design, Arduino, Unity3D. MicrokARts empowers children to design, build, and program their own IoT-enabled karts using a block-based programming environment. The system encourages creative play and collaboration in a shared AR-IoT environment.

ShARed IoT: Shared Experiences in Co-Located Spaces with Augmented Reality and Internet of Things Devices. ShARed IoT is a mobile augmented reality system that wirelessly communicates with custom built electro-mechanical IoT devices. IoT devices are crafted from low-fidelity materials and electronics from our Electronics Repository, and then programmed with our block-based programming tool called IoT Maker. Cloud Anchors enable the sharing and control of AR content across multiple smartphones, and our wireless communication protocol enables control of a users customized ShARed IoT device across those smartphones. Skills: Augmented Reality, IoT, Cloud Anchors, Electronics, Programming.

IoT Maker: Creating High-Level Electro-Mechanical Devices Through Live Programming for Youth. IoT Maker is a web app that uses live programming to simulate various electronic devices. Users (a) drag-and-drop blocks of code into the programming environment and (b) watch their code execute in real-time on the screen, while interacting with sensors via sliders, buttons, and color pickers. Once the user has a sufficient understanding of the functionality of their code, they can (c) upload the code to our customized iBoard, and (d) connect their phone, tablet, or computer to the iBoard, and control the electronics via WiFi. Skills: Augmented Reality, IoT, Curriculum Design, Arduino, Unity3D.

StoryMakAR: Bringing Stories to Life With An Augmented Reality & Physical Prototyping Toolkit for Youth. Overview of StoryMakAR workflow (from left to right). (a) Users build electro-mechanical devices, program them using our drag-and-drop environment, DeviceMakAR, and control them with our plug-and-play MakAR Board. (b) Users create events for their story with EventMakAR. (c) Finally, using an AR-enabled cell phone, users control the physical devices by using the virtual characters to create Virtual-Physical Interactions. Skills: Augmented Reality, IoT, Curriculum Design, Arduino, Unity3D.

Tele-Operation of a 6 DOF Robotic Arm Using ESP32 Over WiFi (IE 590 Final Project). The final project involved designing a 6-DoF robotic arm mounted on a car-like chassis. Controlled by an ESP32 microcontroller and programmed using Arduino IDE, the system featured servo motors, wheels, and electronics. A phone mounted on the chassis streamed its camera feed to a host computer via WiFi. A Unity 3D-based control interface sent UDP messages over WiFi to manage the robot's movements. The project was a culmination of the course, showcasing the integration of hardware and software skills acquired throughout the semester. Skills: Computer Vision, SIFT/SURF, Python, Human-Robot Interaction, ARCore (Android), ARKit (iPhone), Arduino, Unity3D.

Family Tree Generator: A full-stack web application for designing personalized, laser-ready family tree signs. Built for FlareTech Laser & Design, this tool enables customers to create customized wooden signs with 3-18 family names arranged in a heart-shaped tree design. Features include a 3-layer design system (Top Layer for dedication text, Middle Layer for family tree, Bottom Layer for frame), real-time preview, production-ready SVG/PDF export with text-to-path conversion using opentype.js and Paper.js, AI-powered mockup generation via Replicate API, and secure Etsy order verification. Tech stack: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Node.js/Express, Firebase Auth, Firestore, Google Analytics 4. Results: 83% reduction in customization time (30min to 5min), 100% self-service (0 messages needed), 93% error reduction. Skills: Full-Stack Development, React, TypeScript, Firebase, Express.js, Vector Graphics, AI Integration, UX Design.

Family Tree Generator Technical Details: The application uses a sophisticated vector processing pipeline. Text is converted to bezier paths using opentype.js for font parsing, then Paper.js handles boolean path operations (union, subtract) to create continuous outlines suitable for laser cutting. The 3-layer architecture mirrors the physical manufacturing process where stacked layers of different materials create the final sign. Authentication uses Firebase with email/password and Google OAuth, plus Etsy PKCE OAuth for order verification. AI mockup generation uses Replicate's Flux-Pro model with html-to-image for design capture. The system tracks comprehensive analytics including time-to-production, export format preferences, and feature adoption rates.

Family Tree Generator Problem Statement: Before the app, the customization workflow for FlareTech's family tree signs was entirely manual and required approximately 30 minutes per order. Each customer order involved 3-5 back-and-forth messages to clarify names, spellings, and design preferences. Human errors in transcription and font styling occurred in about 15% of orders, leading to costly remakes. As order volume grew, this manual process became the primary bottleneck limiting business scalability. The solution needed to eliminate the communication overhead while maintaining full customization flexibility.

Family Tree Generator 5-Day Design Sprint: Day 1 (Monday) - Design & Planning: Focused on initial Figma designs, defining the color palette, and planning the multi-layer architecture. Day 2 (Tuesday) - Core Editor Development: Built the foundational 3-layer design editor, implemented core SVG rendering logic, and established the real-time preview system. Day 3 (Wednesday) - Vector Export Pipeline: Integrated opentype.js for text-to-path conversion and Paper.js for complex path manipulation, ensuring production-ready SVG/PDF exports. Day 4 (Thursday) - Authentication & Backend: Set up Firebase Authentication, designed the Firestore schema, developed the Express.js backend, and integrated the secure Etsy OAuth flow. Day 5 (Friday) - AI Integration & Launch: Integrated the Replicate AI API for mockup generation, implemented GA4 analytics, polished the UI, and prepared for deployment.

Family Tree Generator System Architecture: The application features three main data flows. (1) Design → Export Flow: User input flows through React state management, dynamic SVG rendering, opentype.js text-to-path conversion, Paper.js path optimization, and finally generates downloadable SVG/PDF files. (2) Authentication Flow: Users log in via Firebase Auth (Email/Password or Google OAuth), the system checks Firestore for valid Etsy purchase records, redirects to Etsy OAuth with PKCE if unverified, and grants access upon successful verification. (3) AI Mockup Flow: The design is captured using html-to-image, uploaded to the Express.js backend, processed by Replicate's Flux-Pro AI model, and the generated mockup URL is displayed to the user.

Family Tree Generator Business Impact: The application achieved transformative results for FlareTech Laser & Design. Customization time was reduced by 83%, from approximately 30 minutes per order to just 5 minutes. Communication rounds were eliminated entirely (100% self-service), going from 3-5 messages per order to zero messages needed. The error rate was reduced by 93%, dropping from 15% of orders requiring corrections to less than 1%. The system now provides unlimited scalability for order volume, removing the previous manual bottleneck. Customer satisfaction remained at 100% with the maintained 5-star Etsy rating.

Family Tree Generator Demo: A live demo of the Family Tree Generator is available at https://tglenn2012.github.io/Family-Tree-Generator/. The demo allows users to experience the full design interface, including adding family names to the heart-shaped tree, selecting fonts, customizing layers, and previewing the design in real-time. A YouTube video walkthrough is also available showing the complete user journey from design to export.

Responsibilities included UX/UI design in Figma, frontend development with React and TypeScript, backend development with Node.js and Express, Firebase integration for authentication and database, Etsy OAuth integration for order verification, Replicate AI integration for mockup generation, vector graphics processing with opentype.js and Paper.js, and analytics implementation with Google Analytics 4.
